read.en: Corning rose 0.6% on Oct 19 to $132.74 after fading from a high of $137.24. It is below all its averages: the falling 5-day ($138.5), 10-day ($148.2) and 30-day ($153.6), the rising 200-day ($153.9) and the falling 100-day ($166.5). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and is below zero with the histogram widening, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 12 ($161.2), and RSI is 36.6.
read.zh: 康宁 10月19日上涨 0.6%，收于 $132.74，盘中自高点 $137.24 回落。股价位于全部均线下方：下行的 5 日（$138.5）、10 日（$148.2）和 30 日均线（$153.6）、上行的 200 日均线（$153.9）以及下行的 100 日均线（$166.5）。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图扩大，抛物线 SAR 自 10月12日起看空（$161.2），RSI 为 36.6。

read.en: The close sat a cent under the $132.75 Oct 15 low, so it was not reclaimed. Resistance is $132.75, then $138.5 (5-day average, Oct 19 high $137.2) and $141.6 (Aug 24 low). Support is $130 (Jul 30 low), then $122.6 (Jul 29 low) and $114.5 (Jul 28 low). A close below $130 would open $122.6; a close above $138.5 would target $141.6.
